@everyone

Here is a fresh Dev update! This round, we wanted to keep it shorter and to the point so that we were not repeating old information. That being said, we have two lists: Currently Being Worked On, and Around the Corner. A much more direct list that you can digest in just a few minutes. As always, if you have any questions just pop them into chat. Happy reading

@everyone 
Calling all Mythic Vehicle, Land, or Dome Owners

We are opening the LAUNCHER ONLY (not the game) for download to mythic holders (of mythic vehicle, land, or dome). This allows us to test the launcher while also giving us the ability to grant game download access to those with the proper hardware specs. Game access for these new users will be granted as soon as possible after we assess and define the hardware criteria based on the results of the Launcher doing the Hardware Spec check.

So right now, you should be able to visit the Cornucopias website and log in. Once logged in, you will find the download button in the top navigation (available on Windows only). After downloading, you can run it to install the desktop launcher. We hope everything goes smoothly, but if you encounter any issues, please ⁠open-support-ticket.

Following that, all those who have downloaded and run the launcher with the appropriate hardware and mythic holders will gain access to the game. This will happen in the coming days, so we appreciate your patience. We are just as excited to get this game into your hands as you are to play it.

@everyone 
We are pleased to announce that the next group of testers has been given access to install the game and start testing.

If you have one of the 15 Mythic assets, and one of the GPUs listed below, then all you need to do is open up the Launcher and click Install.
note: The GPU list will be expanded over time as we test and fine tune.


Congratulations to those who now have Mythic Access to test Calido Valley Early Access.
